reviews.title: Dead on arrival
reviews.comment: Got it setup in my wife's new PC......and nothing. Wouldn't even register as being in the slot. Integrated graphics worked fine, and even my 7800x3d did great but the GPU just will not register so I looks like a DOA. Just wanted amazon to do an exchange for a good one, but now they will only let me do a refund (which takes forever and a day). Had hopes for it, since it's MSi, but even they get bad units it looks like.
reviews.author: Heather Johnson
